title: Grow Ahead
description: Watch your forests come to life! A lightweight mod that lets trees naturally grow fruits and berries on their leaves for Fabric & NeoForge.
body:
**Grow Ahead** brings Minecraft trees to life by allowing them to naturally grow fruits and berries directly on their leaves! 

![A player in Minecraft collects apples off leaves to demonstrate how the mod works](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/VVeHM8nY/images/6497bad5e892f28c7fd83270dbec5bf3e5d81bf2.gif)

### 🌲 Features
* **Tree-Specific Fruits:** Different trees yield different resources based on their type:
  * **Oak & Birch:** Grow crisp **Apples**.
  * **Jungle:** Grows **Cocoa Beans**.
  * **Mangrove:** Grows **Glow Berries**.
  * **Dark Oak:** Grows **Sweet Berries**.
* **Biome-Based Growth:** Temperature matters! Fruits flourish in warm biomes (Jungles, Forests) but will freeze and refuse to grow in cold, snowy environments.

### ⚙️ Compatibility
* Fully supports both **Fabric** and **NeoForge**!
* Works seamlessly on both **Singleplayer (Client)** and **Multiplayer (Server-side)**.
